skillPoints.notes: 1 skill point per character level from levels 2-50. Capped at 49 from leveling alone. Additional points from renown (up to 10) and paragon boards are not tracked here.

paragonPoints.notes: 4 paragon points per paragon level. Paragon progression begins after reaching character level 60. Maximum paragon level is 300 (1200 points from leveling). Additional points from renown are not tracked here.
